brief.brand: Trường Mầm non Quốc tế Sunrise Kids
brief.kpi: 300 lượt đăng ký tham quan trường
brief.notes: Trường mầm non quốc tế học phí cao, chỉ có 1 campus tại TP.HCM. Nhắm cha mẹ có con dưới 6 tuổi, thu nhập cao. Quảng cáo hướng tới phụ huynh, không hướng tới trẻ nhỏ.

labels.labeler_note:
Geo=HCM-only is the conflicting call (single campus); must_not_set=Under 18 reflects that the buyer/decision-maker is the parent, not the (legally too young to be targeted) child.

Human review 2026-07-16: accepted and applied the independent audit. Parent labels identify buyers, but the 310-segment catalog has no preschool/early-childhood education interest. Higher education is an education-level near miss, not an actively wrong parent audience. Remaining catalog gap is intentional; no substitute label was invented.

targeting.note: Single-campus HCM-only school explicitly conflicts with a nationwide default; the audience is parents, so age must never be set to the child's own bracket.
